purpose: Evaluate the completed first interval before any further training
panel: Exact ordered 16 baseline IDs; first two sorted development worlds, both languages, original/swapped_values/empty/ordinary_original
neural_fusion: Python FP32 loaded from checkpoint; source independently encoded by bound C encoder
generation: Fresh ordinary C reference, fresh C base, fresh C continuous projection at every predicted token
zero_trained_residual: Allowed and recorded; unlike the untrained perturbation diagnostic it is not an error
review: Two independent blind model reviewers; retain disagreement, missing, truncation and all denominators
scope: Single supplied episode component; not automatic write, full C fusion, HTTP or LoCoMo
stop: No additional optimizer steps or deployment before reviewing raw answers and paired controls
